review_candidates.title: Operator (Fuelling)
review_candidates.location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
review_candidates.description: Job Purpose Performs safe and timely re-fuelling/de-fuelling of aircrafts in full compliance to Aviation Standards, Airport Regulations and ADNOC standards and requirements in a safe and efficient manner. Coordinates with customer representatives at the aircraft and report all customer feedback, operational and safety issues and vehicle defects to the supervisor and maintenance team. Perform quality control checks on product as per laid down standards of ADNOC Aviation Division Quality Control procedures. Perform the job safely in line with HSE policy, Airport Safety and regulations and ADNOC Integrated Management system. Job Specific Accountabilities Fuelling Operations Refuel and defuel customer aircrafts as per his assigned schedule, ensuring that all operations are carried out properly and efficiently in accordance with company standards. Receiving all relevant details, from Superior of amount of fuel to be supplied, type of dispenser or fueller, Aircraft parking, Gate No., type of Aircraft etc. before conducting the fuelling operation. Checks refuelling vehicle before proceeding to an aircraft to ensure that there are no defects with the equipment and reports any malfunctioning to supervisor for necessary action. Drives to apron following the speed limits, positions refuelling vehicle near aircraft as required. Connects bonding hoses to aircraft and hydrant pit as applicable. Ensures hoses and nozzle are secured as per the prescribed standards. Disconnect hoses, bonding after completion of fuelling operations. During supplying fuel, checks in and around vehicle in the interests of safety, drives vehicle to aircraft fuelling point, connects hose, starts the refuelling process, takes samples, disconnects hose, fills in receipt. Completes all related documentations and obtains signature from the customer's representative or agent and gives signed copy to the rep/agent. Drives safely after completion of refuelling operations to the depot or approaches another aircraft as directed. Ensures the safety of the property as well as the apron staff. Keep a constant vigil on the fuelling process, fuelling vehicle and operations surrounding. Verify the fuel requirement with aircraft technician/pilot and start the fuelling with his instruction Perform the product visual check as per Aviation Quality Manual during fuelling and completion of fuelling. Job Specific Accountabilities2 Refuelling with Refueller Vehicle Check the available quantity in assigned refueller and drive the assigned refueller following airport safety and security rules. Position the refueller safely and properly and connect the fuelling equipment as per Aviation Operating Manual. Verify the fuel requirement with aircraft technician/pilot and start the fuelling with his instruction. Complete the delivery ticket process through car PC or prepare Manual ticket. Disconnect the fuelling equipment as per Aviation Operation Manual and verify all hoses are on place. Load the Refueller Vehicle when required as per the instruction from Supervisor Perform Defueling: Position the Refueler safely and properly and verify the flight details with noted details. Take sample from aircraft tank and perform Quality Control Check as per Aviation Operations Manual. Connect the fuelling equipment as per Aviation Operating Manual. Verify the defuel requirement with aircraft technician/pilot and start the defueling with his instruction. Stop the defueling based on Refueler capacity and technician advice then complete the delivery ticket process. Disconnect the defueling equipment as per Aviation Operation Manual and verify all hoses are on place. Inform the shift supervisor about the defueling completion and wait for further instruction. HSE Follows the operations emergency plans and evacuation procedures and can use the safety equipment and fire extinguishers. Participate in all the operations’ HSE campaigns, training courses, awareness sessions and initiatives deployment to ensure meeting the objectives per each. Ensure full compliance to PPE and other safety regulations when assuming all the operations Reports all Incidents and Near Misses, immediately to the supervisor Follows company emergency and the operations group procedures and participates in Emergency drills accordingly. Fire-Fighting Operations Carry out regular and surprise rounds of critical areas of operation as well as facilities to ensure that fire equipment are in workable conditions at all times and stop/ report unsafe precedents. Inspect, clean and test fire-fighting apparatus, tools and equipment, including hose and hose fittings, hydrants, ladders and hand extinguishers to ensure all firefighting equipment are in good condition and ready to be used when required. Respond to fire or accident alarms from the plants control rooms, determine the approach to fire’s location, make the necessary hose connections to fixed fire hydrants, and start firefighting using appropriate fighting tools according to the source of fire. Participate in taking emergency actions dictated by the situation to ensure quick and immediate response to the emergency. Job Specific Accountabilities3 Product Quality Takes regular fuel samples before, during and after refuelling from filter inlet / sump/ outlet, as per procedure, to check the fuel quality. Perform quality checks on different fixed/ mobile equipment as per aviation requirement and as assigned by the supervisor. Equipment Maintenance Carries out daily/weekly/monthly serviceability checks of mobile and static fuelling equipment as and when assigned by the supervisor. Carries out manual tasks as necessary in the depot and apron including pits cleaning, , hose pulling, connecting, disconnecting and taking samples, replenishing refuellers, etc. as required and according to the defined procedures. Tops up Gas oil on mobile units as needed. Report the defects and problems to the shift supervisor and log them in the maintenance logbook. Customer Support: Help and support the customer whenever its needed. Guide the customers to the safe practices if needed and Report customers concerns to the shift supervisor. Minimum Qualification Secondary/high School Certificate. Minimum Experience, Knowledge & Skills 3 years of experience as Fuelling operator Revenues/ Budget: As per approved financial budget Direct Reports: As per organization chart Indirect Reports: As per organization chart

review_candidates.description: Location(s): Gloucester, London or Manchester BAE Systems Digital Intelligence is home to 4,500 digital, cyber and intelligence experts. We work collaboratively across 10 countries to collect, connect and understand complex data, so that governments, nation states, armed forces and commercial businesses can unlock digital advantage in the most demanding environments. National Security at BAE Digital Intelligence Requisition ID: 68897 Location: Gloucester, London or Manchester - Hybrid working offered, with consideration for both full and part-time applicants - please speak to your recruiter about the options Grade: GG08 - GG13 We are growing rapidly and are looking for security cleared engineers, consultants and delivery professionals to join our team. We are proud of the work we do in National Security and the difference we make to the safety and prosperity of the UK. Our areas of expertise It Is The In-depth Expertise And Creativity Of Our People Which Make NS a Success. We Have Opportunities To Expand Our Team In Several Areas, Including Operational Cyber Software Engineering Infrastructure Engineering Business & Technical Consultancy Cyber Security Consulting Data Consultancy and Engineering Delivery and Project management Support and Managed Services User Experience design and build. You’ll be part of a big company, but we try to create a culture that feels more like a small one. The work will stretch you and be challenging, but we encourage a healthy work-life balance and welcome a discussion on flexible working. Most of all, we know that teams who work well together also perform well. We’ll do everything we can to ensure you have fun both at work and in our social activities outside of it. We are specifically recruiting for our National Security business which is the largest area within our Government division. Our mission is to be the most trusted partner for our National Security clients in delivery of their core mission. We have a rich history of working within National Security. In fact, we have over 50 years’ experience of delivering advice and solutions to our customers in this sector, supporting them in carrying out their vital missions. We are currently at the forefront of introducing new technology and approaches, and would like you to be part of this exciting phase in our history. What We Are Made Of We pride ourselves on being able to solve some of our customers’ most complex problems. That ability is based on the skills and experience of our people and our culture, which respects and supports the individual. Our people are what differentiate us, they are ingenious, innovative and dedicated. We have a mix of generalists and specialists and recognise that this diversity contributes to our success. In general, we work in teams. We recognise the benefits of forming teams from a mix of disciplines, which allows us to come up with balanced, high quality solutions. We work hard and often go the extra mile, but we recognise people’s efforts and that everyone has a life outside of work. We encourage people to speak up if they want to rotate to a new project in support of career development, or even just to face a new challenge. We also support flexible working and keeping a healthy work/life balance. Our breadth across the National Security sector provides diverse opportunities for our people to develop their careers in new areas of expertise or with new clients, if they choose. Security Clearance Due to the nature of our work, successful candidates for this role will be required to hold an active eDV before applying for this opportunity. Why BAE Systems? This is a place where you’ll be able to make a real difference. You’ll be part of an inclusive culture that values diversity of thought, rewards integrity, and merit, and where you’ll be empowered to fulfil your potential. We welcome people from all backgrounds and want to make sure that our recruitment processes are as inclusive as possible. If you have a disability or health condition (for example dyslexia, autism, an anxiety disorder etc.) that may affect your performance in certain assessment types, please speak to your recruiter about potential reasonable adjustments. Please be aware that many roles at BAE Systems are subject to both security and export control restrictions. These restrictions mean that factors such as your nationality, any nationalities you may have previously held, and your place of birth can restrict the roles you are eligible to perform within the organisation. All applicants must as a minimum achieve Baseline Personnel Security Standard. Many roles also require higher levels of National Security Vetting where applicants must typically have 5 to 10 years of continuous residency in the UK depending on the vetting level required for the role, to allow for meaningful security vetting checks. Life at BAE Systems Digital Intelligence We are embracing Hybrid Working. This means you and your colleagues may be working in different locations, such as from home, another BAE Systems office or client site, some or all of the time, and work might be going on at different times of the day. By embracing technology, we can interact, collaborate and create together, even when we’re working remotely from one another. Hybrid Working allows for increased flexibility in when and where we work, helping us to balance our work and personal life more effectively, and enhance well-being. Inclusion is integral to the success of BAE Systems Digital Intelligence. We are proud to have an organisational culture where employees with varying perspectives, skills, life experiences and backgrounds – the best and brightest minds – can work together to achieve excellence and realise individual and organisational potential. Division overview: Capabilities At BAE Systems Digital Intelligence, we pride ourselves in being a leader in the cyber defence industry, and Capabilities is the engine that keeps the business moving forward. It is the largest area of Digital Intelligence, containing our Engineering, Consulting and Project Management teams that design and implement the defence solutions and digital transformation projects that make us a globally recognised brand in both the public and private sector. As a member of the Capabilities team, you will be creating and managing the solutions that earn us our place in an ever changing digital world. We all have a role to play in defending our clients, and this is yours.

review_candidates.description: About Us At Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive “sick-care” to proactive health care. Our award-winning whole body scan is fast (under 1 hour), safe (MRI has no ionizing radiation), and non-invasive (no contrast). Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient-centric experience across our domestic and global clinics, have allowed us to lead the change against “we caught it too late again". Reporting to Executive Medical Leadership, the Medical Director, UAE will lead Prenuvo's clinical operations in Dubai while maintaining an active clinical practice. This is a highly visible leadership role responsible for ensuring exceptional patient care, supporting physician excellence, driving quality initiatives, and representing Prenuvo within the UAE healthcare community. Unlike a traditional Medical Director role, this position combines clinical leadership, radiology expertise, operational partnership, physician mentorship, and patient engagement. The successful candidate will help shape Prenuvo's model of preventative healthcare while serving as a trusted clinical leader for both patients and physicians. This role does not provide visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the UAE at the time of hire and must be able to maintain valid work authorization for the duration of their employment. Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise - join us to make a difference in people’s lives! What You’ll Do Clinical Leadership Lead the clinical strategy and medical operations for Prenuvo Radiology UAE. Maintain an active clinical workload (up to 50%) through whole-body MRI interpretation and patient imaging report review. Support complex case reviews and provide second opinions when required. Act as the senior clinical resource for physicians, radiologists, and clinic teams. Work closely with the global clinical leadership team to uphold Prenuvo's global clinical standards. Quality & Physician Excellence Lead clinical quality assurance initiatives, including peer review, discrepancy audits, and continuous improvement programs. Coach and mentor radiologists and partner physicians through ongoing education and performance feedback. Support physician onboarding, credentialing, and professional development. Foster a culture of clinical excellence, accountability, and patient-first care. Ensure a consistently exceptional patient experience aligned with Prenuvo's premium care model. Build trust with patients by providing clear, compassionate communication throughout their care journey. Market & Business Leadership Serve as Prenuvo's clinical representative within the UAE healthcare community. Build relationships with referring physicians, healthcare partners, and regulatory stakeholders. Provide insight into local healthcare trends, physician recruitment, and market opportunities. Partner with Operations, Product, Quality, and Commercial teams to optimise clinical workflows and scale the business. Clinical Innovation Support the implementation of AI-enabled workflows and advancements in preventative imaging. Standardise reporting, clinical pathways, and best practices across the UAE clinic. Champion innovation while ensuring the highest standards of patient safety and clinical governance. What You’ll Bring Medical degree with specialist certification in Radiology. Active Dubai Health Authority (DHA) medical license. Minimum of 3 years' experience practicing within the UAE healthcare system. Internationally trained physician (preference for medical degree and Radiology training to be completed from UK, Australia, United States or internationally recognised European healthcare system) Strong understanding of UAE healthcare regulations, licensing requirements, and clinical governance. Proven experience interpreting MRI studies in a high-quality diagnostic imaging environment. Leadership Experience Prior experience leading physicians or multidisciplinary clinical teams. Demonstrated success driving quality improvement and physician development. Strong clinical judgment with the ability to manage complex patient situations. Excellent communication and relationship-building skills. Prior experience leading a private for-profit clinical enterprise. Prior experience implementing novel clinical technology and services ahead of consensus. Ideal Candidate We're Looking For a Physician Who Combines Exceptional bedside manner Strong leadership capabilities Deep knowledge of the UAE healthcare landscape Passion for preventative medicine Commercial awareness and business acumen Ability to thrive in a fast-growing, innovative healthcare environment Familiar with and accepting of the ambiguity of a start-up environment Comfortable with taking calculated risks as part of a broader team Our Values First: we are Pioneers Transforming healthcare requires divergent thinking, bias for action, disciplined experimentation, and consistent grit and determination to maintain momentum. This journey is as challenging as it is rewarding. Second: we are Platform-Builders We’re always building foundations that allow us to achieve tomorrow more than we did today. We never lose sight of what’s ahead – in a mindset of ownership and duty to our mission. Above all: we are Patients We could all be the next person who walks through our very doors, seeking clarity or peace of mind. We are proud of our impact on our patients’ lives, and we won’t stop till everyone can benefit from our work. What We Offer Lead the future of preventative healthcare in the UAE, bringing a new approach to proactive, data-driven health and early detection. Shape a first-of-its-kind patient experience, setting a new standard for personalised, preventative healthcare. Collaborate with global clinical and technology leaders at the forefront of advanced MRI, AI and preventative medicine. Play a key role in establishing and scaling Prenuvo across the Middle East, helping shape our clinical vision and regional growth. Balance meaningful clinical practice with strategic leadership, remaining close to patients while influencing clinical standards, innovation and growth. Join a mission-driven global organisation transforming how people understand and manage their long-term health. Competitive executive compensation and benefits package, reflective of the scope and impact of the role. We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Please be advised that official communication from our recruitment team will only come from our authorized domain [ prenuvo.com ]. If you are contacted by a recruiter, please ensure their email address ends with @prenuvo.com. We do not use third-party recruitment services or any other email domains for hiring purposes. If you receive communication that you believe to be fraudulent, please report it immediately to jobs@prenuvo.com.

Working closely with the Chief Engineer and cross-functional teams, this role manages multiple projects to ensure design integrity, compliance with customer specifications and industry standards, and timely execution within scope and budget. Responsibilities include reviewing and approving designs, performing calculations, driving product improvements and innovation, and providing hands-on support for fabrication, installation, and troubleshooting, with occasional travel to support field activities. Key Responsibilities Work independently with minimal supervision while managing multiple projects in parallel. Lead projects related to contracts, standardization, product improvement, and R&D initiatives. Ensure overall design integrity and adherence to customer specifications and industry standards. Deliver projects according to defined scope, schedule, and budget. Collaborate with other engineering disciplines (Process, Electrical, Automation, etc.) to meet project deliverables. Analyze complex design challenges and develop innovative solutions. Review and approve engineering designs, including 3D models, detailed drawings, and mechanical calculations. Work with global resources to complete engineering deliverables efficiently. Travel to job sites and regional offices as needed for equipment troubleshooting, fabrication and manufacturing support, installation assistance, and sales support. Support standardization, product improvement, and value engineering initiatives to optimize performance and cost. Contribute to research and development projects to advance product innovation. Contribute to the development of design standards, product specifications, and design control procedures. Actively participate in a collaborative team environment to achieve project and organizational goals. What You Bring Education & Experience Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field. Successful completion of EIT Exam (Engineer in Training) or FE (Fundamentals of Engineering). 3+ years of experience in mechanical design and engineering. Proven track record of managing engineering projects from concept to completion. Technical Skills Proficiency in mechanical engineering and machine design principles, calculations, and analysis. Proficiency in CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, AutoCAD) and 3D modeling. Competency in CAE software (e.g., Ansys). Proficiency in MS Office software (e.g., Word, Excel, PowerPoint). Good understanding of manufacturing processes and materials. Familiarity with industry standards and regulatory requirements. Basic understanding of design requirements of other engineering disciplines: electrical, process, etc. Leadership & Soft Skills Proficiency in project management and organizational skills. Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities. Effective communication and collaboration skills. Commitment to safety and quality standards. Preferred Successful completion of PE Exam (or equivalent). Experience with value engineering and product development. Knowledge of sourcing strategies and cost optimization. Willingness to travel for site visits and client support. What We Offer As an equal opportunity employer, FLSmidth embraces diversity and equality by promoting an environment of inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds and perspectives to apply - the more diverse our employees are, the stronger our team is. PLEASE NOTE CURRENT VALID US VISA IS NON-NEGOTIABLE. We offer all employees access to a dedicated recognition platform, empowering you to celebrate achievements, share appreciation and stay connected globally.
